# Kition Film — instructions for agents

Kition Film is a clean-room, open-source, pure-Rust non-linear video editor targeting Adobe Premiere Pro parity (and beyond): `kit.film` for Kition. The engine compiles to WebAssembly for the in-page editor (`bindings/wasm`) and runs headless for Kition's agent (`bindings/headless`). Sibling of `../kition-photo` (Photoshop), `../kition-pdf` (Acrobat) and `../kition-vector` (Illustrator), with the same conventions.

## Start every session here
`plan/` is maintainer-local (gitignored, not in the repo). Each step names the public equivalent to use if you don't have it.
1. Read `plan/STATUS.md` (current milestone, next unchecked task, blockers). Public: [`docs/roadmap.md`](../docs/roadmap.md).
2. Read the task in `plan/execution-plan.md` §3, the relevant section of `plan/architecture.md`, and the README/docs of the crate you touch. Public: [`docs/architecture.md`](../docs/architecture.md), [`docs/development.md`](../docs/development.md), [`docs/testing/README.md`](../docs/testing/README.md).
3. Follow the autonomous operation protocol (`plan/execution-plan.md` §7). Don't stop to ask unless it lists the decision as the user's.

## Non-negotiables
**Read [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) first; its rules override everything here.**
- **Never crash** ([`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) §0). People depend on Kition Film; a crash loses their work, so this outranks feature work. No `unwrap`/`expect`/`panic!`/`unreachable!`/`todo!`/`unimplemented!` or `unsafe` outside tests: return `Result<T, E>` and propagate with `?` (`ok_or`, `let … else`, `if let`). Treat every number from media, project files, presets or command params as hostile: `get()` instead of `[i]`, checked/saturating math, no division by possibly-zero values, capped allocations, bounded recursion. `lock().unwrap_or_else(PoisonError::into_inner)`; background jobs run under `catch_unwind`. Every crash fix gets a regression test that panicked before. In particular (§1): never use Adobe iconography, images or any other Adobe asset. Every asset must be openly licensed (OSS / public domain / Creative Commons, or original work by a contributor) and must have a `<file>.attribution` sidecar plus an entry in `docs/attribution.md`. `cargo xtask assets` enforces this.
- **Fonts** live in [KitionAI/kition-fonts](https://github.com/KitionAI/kition-fonts), never in this repo (no new font files here; [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) §1.8). Build with them: `git clone https://github.com/KitionAI/kition-fonts ../kition-fonts && KITION_FONTS_DIR="$PWD/../kition-fonts" cargo build -p kition-film-kit` (`crates/support/text/build.rs` embeds them as `kition_film_text::fonts::KITION_FONTS`, used for Japanese in titles and captions). Unset, `KITION_FONTS` is empty and everything must still build, test and run; never add kition-fonts to a `Cargo.toml`. Tests on its glyphs skip when it is empty, so run the gates with and without `KITION_FONTS_DIR` when you touch fonts.
- **Clean-room.** Never read/disassemble anything inside Adobe app bundles (names/listings only). Never copy Adobe icons, presets, LUTs, fonts. Never copy GPL/LGPL/AGPL code (FFmpeg, x264, x265, MLT, Kdenlive, Shotcut, Olive, LAME…). ffmpeg/ffprobe run only as external test oracles / fixture generators — never linked or shipped.
- **Pure Rust**, no `unsafe` anywhere in this repository (`unsafe_code = "forbid"` for the whole workspace; [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) §0.3).
- **Layering** ([`docs/architecture.md`](../docs/architecture.md) §1, enforced by `cargo xtask layers`): L0 codec/container crates depend only on `kition-film-bitstream`.
- **Exact time:** all time is `kition_film_time::Tick` (254 016 000 000/s). Never use f64 seconds for edit math.
- **Everything is a command** (`crates/engine/engine`): id, label, params, enabled(), run(). The editor and the headless executable both dispatch by id, and every command carries an agent schema.
- **Checks and CI.** On this machine run only the fast checks: `cargo fmt --all -- --check`, `cargo check -p <touched crates> --all-targets`, the wasm `cargo check` (`cargo xtask wasm`, which checks L0–L4 crates and `kition-film-kit`) and `pnpm typecheck` in `web/`. The full checks run in the kit's CI run on GitHub (`.github/workflows/ci.yml` calls Kition's reusable kit CI): clippy, `cargo test --workspace`, `cargo xtask ci` (`cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings`, `cargo test --workspace`, `cargo xtask layers`, `cargo xtask assets`, `cargo xtask wasm`) and every `test:*` script of `web/`. A task is done when the CI run of HEAD is green and HEAD is on `origin/main` (Kition's `scripts/kit-ci.sh` `push`, `wait`, `land`). Do not add other workflows, and do not start the Package workflow: releasing is the owner's step.
- **Commits:** one task id per commit (`M2.4: CABAC residual decoding`). Only green states. End messages with the attribution line required by the environment.

## Running and looking at the editor
- `cd web && pnpm install && pnpm engine && pnpm dev` builds the WebAssembly engine and serves `web/dev.html`, a standalone host for manual testing without Kition.
- `cargo build -p kition-film` builds the headless executable Kition's agent drives (`kition-headless` protocol); there is no desktop window or control channel.
- Agents commit on `main` in this checkout; one agent per repository at a time. Keep every `Cargo.toml` valid at all times (the `crates/*` glob means one broken manifest breaks everyone).
- Test fixtures: generate with ffmpeg into `target/fixtures/` (never commit media). See [`docs/testing/README.md`](../docs/testing/README.md).
